Commentary.Commentary: Right! That is all from the first Afg-WI T20I. A damp squib, I am afraid. There is not much time for a turnaround. Because the second and third T20Is will be played on successive days - Saturday and Sunday. Afghanistan really do not have enough time to even think what happened here. Good thing is that there is no travel to different venues. Join us on Saturday, November 16, 2019 at 7 pm local (1330 GMT). ADIOS! TAKE CARE!

Victorious West Indian skipper, Kieron Pollard, has been named the MAN OF THE MATCH. Feels that it is always good to contribute and even better when it comes in a winning cause. Praises Lewis and Hetmyer for setting up the platform. Then lauds the bowlers for restricting the score well. Admits that it was not the easiest pitches to bat on and hence the conditions dictated of taking one's time, running hard between the wickets and when the ball is not there for shot-making, maneuver the strike well and play smart cricket. On Allen's absence making them a bowler short, Pollard says that in T20 cricket, normally there are plenty of bowling options, so they were used to it. Praises Jason Holder and Sheldon Cottrell for bowling an exceptional opening spell which tightened the noose on the Afghans.

Afghanistan skipper, Rashid Khan, believes that it was a toss which should have been won and they did bowl well in the first 10 overs. Also feels that 165 was a total which should have been chased down. But then, blames the batsmen for not stepping up. Adds that there are 2 more games left, so hopes to learn from the mistakes committed in this game. Agrees that the series is all about giving youngsters an opportunity as there is plenty of upcoming talent in the country. But believes that in spite of the inexperience due to the young guys, which will take some time to gain confidence, it will prove helpful come the Asia Cup and the World Twenty20.

Is it fair to say that Evin Lewis was the differentiator between the two sides? Probably not. West Indies showed more application than the Afghans and this has been a case not only here but right from the ODIs. Who would your Man Of The Match be? Evin Lewis? Kieron Pollard? Kesrick Williams? Please stay tuned for the presenation...

Then, with the ball, the Windies did not let the effect of the dew hamper them at all. They seemed well prepared as they bowled well, managing tight lines and keeping the Afghans quiet. Just 4 batsmen managed double figures and only 2 sixes were hit in the run chase. Everyone bowled well but Kesrick Williams bagged the most wickets with 3/17 in his 4 overs. Mind you, they were a bowler short, losing Fabian Allen due to injury on the field. Yet, had 6 bowlers.

Now, we have got to hand it to the Caribbeans. On a track which was staying low, Lewis took the game away from the 'hosts' while Pollard provided the knockout punch towards the end, even though Afghanistan did manage to come back after Hetmyer's wicket. Lewis' blitz of 68 from 41 balls on a wicket like this was priceless.

Comfortably done in the end. 164 did look 20-30 runs below par at the halfway mark but it turned out to be 20-30 more than par. The 2016 WT20 champions have played like one, batting well on a sluggish track and then bowling exceedingly well in spite of the dew.
That ends the game! Good length ball on off, Ahmad lofts this one over the cover fielder and takes a couple. West Indies defeat Afghanistan by 30 runs and maintain their unbeaten run on this tour.
Ahmad comes down the track to this length ball but misses his swing at it.
FOUR! Shortish in length, Ahmad pulls and pulls powerfully. The ball races away to the mid-wicket fence. Too late for Afghanistan.
On the pads, Mujeeb flicks this one towards mid-wicket for a single.
Another one on off, Ahmad lofts this one towards long off for one.
Shortish again, Ahmad chips this one down the ground for a couple.
Sherfane Rutherford is back on. 2-0-18-0 are his figures so far.
Driven through mid off by the batsman. One run added to the total.
FOUR! Beautiful shot! Floated on off, lofted over covers for a boundary.
Mujeeb slaps this one down to long off for one.
Again Mujeeb reverse sweeps but this time straight to Williams.

FOUR! Reverse sweep brought out again! Mujeeb connects beautifully to this full ball outside off and lofts it over short third man for a boundary. Williams from short third man gives it a chase, dives but fails to pull it back in.
Shortish delivery on middle, Ahmad pulls this one towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Mujeeb pulls this one towards mid-wicket for a couple.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.
Mujeeb looks to flick this one down the leg side but misses to get hit on the thigh pad.
Full ball on middle, Williams defends it back to the bowler.
Mujeeb Ur Rahman is the last man in.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! West Indies 1 wicket away from victory now. Short ball wide outside off, Naveen comes down the track and looks to pull. But the bounce gets big on him and he gets a faint edge on it. Ramdin behind takes an easy catch.

Naveen goes for the reverse sweep again. This time Williams cleverly bowls it down the leg side. Naveen wants it to be called a wide but the umpire says that it is a legal delivery. Now, the batsman is not happy at all. He looks at the square leg umpire and then at the main one. Walks down the track and is fuming in anger, wanting that to be called a wide or a no ball for height. It was definitely not a no ball while as far as the wide quotient is concerned, it could not be called as the batsman was trying to play it on the opposite side.
Naveen has played it towards mid-wicket. One run added to the total.
Fuller one outside off, Naveen looks to jam it out but misses.
FOUR! Reverse swept! Full ball on off, Naveen gets down on one knee and awkwardly reverse sweeps down towards third man for a boundary.
Floated on off, pushed towards cover for one.
FOUR! Great shot! Shortish and on off, Ahmad makes room and smashes this one over extra cover for a boundary.
Naveen-ul-Haq is the new batsman in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Afghanistan lose another wicket and Naib is the man to go now. Floated delivery outside off, Naib looks to slog sweep this towards mid-wicket for a biggie. Naib gets a top edge on this one which goes towards long off where Sheldon Cottrell takes the catch. A matter of time before Afghanistan lose now.
FOUR! Nice shot. Short delivery on off, Ahmad slaps it through covers for a boundary. 100 up for Afghanistan.
On a good length on off, Ahmad blocks it out.
Short delivery, Ahmad looks to pull but misses it.
Good length delivery on middle, Ahmad nudges it to the leg side.
Play and a miss! On a good length and outside off, Ahmad looks to cut but misses it.
Fareed Ahmad comes out to bat.

OUT! CAUGHT! West Indies are three wickets away from winning the match. On a good length and outside off, Rashid looks to go big but gets an outside edge. It goes to Denesh Ramdin who takes a good catch moving to his right.
Kesrick Williams is back on. 2-0-11-1 are his figures so far.
Wide outside off, Naib looks to lash at it but fails.
On the pads, pulled towards mid-wicket for a single.
Shortish outside off, Rashid plays this to point.
Naib pushes this one towards long off and gets a single this time.
Naib rocks onto the back foot and pushes it towards cover.

OUT! CAUGHT! Afghanistan falling apart now with the run rate climbing. Hayden Walsh drags this one back. Nabi looks to pull this one over the mid-wicket fence. However, he does not get the timing on it and the ball goes to Jason Holder at deep mid-wicket who takes an easy catch. Afghanistan have now lost 2 wickets in the last 3 balls. Rashid Khan, the Afghanistan skipper now walks out to bat.
Length delivery on off, Nabi taps it towards point for a single.
Gulbadin Naib is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Short delivery on off, Zadran looks to pull but gets a top edge on this one. It goes high in the air and Denesh Ramdin moves to his right and catches it near the leg slip region. Afghanistan have lost half their side back in the hut.
SIX! That is huge! Short of a length delivery, bowls slower, Zadran pulls it over mid-wicket for a maximum.
Full delivery on middle, Zadran drives it through mid off. The batsmen get two runs.
WIDE! Bowls it wide outside off, Zadran lets it go.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
BEATEN! On a good length and outside off, Zadran looks to go big but misses it.
Kieron Pollard is back on. 2-0-7-1 are his figures so far.
On a length on middle, Zadran flicks it towards square leg. The batsmen take a run.

On a good length on leg, Zadran looks to flick but gets hit on the pads. The bowler appeals but the umpire shakes his head. Probably it was pitching outside leg. Nabi walks down the track for the single but Najib sends him back. Not quite sure what is wrong. Looks like Zadran has hurt himself here.
FOUR! Nice shot. Full delivery outside off, Zadran drives it through point for a boundary.
Full toss on middle, Nabi flicks it through mid-wicket. The batsmen take a single.
On a good length on leg, Zadran looks to flick but gets an inside edge onto the pads. It goes towards the leg side. The batsmen cross ends.
Short delivery on middle, Nabi pulls it through mid-wicket. The batsmen take a run.
Jason Holder is back on. 3-0-21-1 are his figures so far.
Length delivery on middle, Nabi flicks it towards square leg for a run.
On a length on off, Zadran punches it towards point for a run.
Short of a length delivery outside off, Najibullah looks to pull but misses it.
BEATEN! On a good length and outside off, Zadran looks to cut but misses it.
Short delivery outside off, Nabi cuts it through point. The batsmen take a single.
Short delivery on off, Nabi cuts it to point.
WIDE! Bowls it down the leg side, Nabi looks to flick but misses it.
Sherfane Rutherford comes back on. 1-0-14-0 are his figures so far.
On a good length on off, Zadran plays it to point.
Short on middle, Nabi pulls it through square leg for a single.
Short delivery on middle, Zadran pulls it through mid-wicket for a run.
Length delivery on middle, Nabi flicks it towards fine leg for a run.
On a good length on off, Zadran plays it towards the off side and takes a run.
Mohammad Nabi walks in.

OUT! CAUGHT! The third umpire gives it out. Short of a length delivery, Afghan pulls it over mid-wicket but does not get the distance on it. It goes towards substitute Keemo Paul who runs in to take the catch just inches above the ground. The fielder is not claiming it at all and that prompts the umpires to refer it upstairs. The soft signal is out, I guess because it is not possible to check whether the catch is clean. However, in the end, the third umpire gives it out. Paul is not in the T20I squad, yet has come out to field. Allowed?

Is that a wicket? That is a stunning catch, if taken. But substitute Keemo Paul is not claiming it. The umpire has referred it upstairs. Looks to be a clean catch as per the second replay, which is front on. He is adjudged OUT, because of the soft signal.
Kieron Pollard is back on. 1-0-3-0 so far.
FOUR! Another one! Bad bowling by Walsh and Zadran punishes him as he rocks back and lofts this one over short fine leg for a boundary.
FOUR! Slapped away! Shortish on middle, Zadran pulls this one hardly towards square leg for a boundary.
This one turns in from middle, Zadran just about brings his bat down in time and guides it to short third man.
Afghan punches this one towards point for one.
Shortish again, Zadran pulls this one towards mid-wicket for a single.
Shortish outside off, cut to point for one.
Hayden Walsh is into the attack. It is his T20I debut for West Indies tonight. He has played for USA before.
Length ball outside off, Zadran plays it towards point. 3 runs off the over and a wicket.
Wide! Down the leg side, Zadran looks to flick but misses.
Short of a length ball on middle, Afghan pulls this one towards long on for one.

Length ball on middle and leg, Afghan looks to work this one fine down the leg side but misses his flick. The ball hits Afghan on the pad and Williams appeals. The umpire is unmoved. Looks to be going down leg.
Length ball outside off, Zadran cuts this one towards point and takes a run.
Full ball on off, Zadran defends this one towards cover.
Najibullah Zadran is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Zazai departs! Change of bowling works for Pollard! Williams bowls a good length ball outside off, Zazai looks to slam it down the ground towards long off. However, Zazai only manages to get a faint edge on it and the ball goes to Ramdin who takes an easy catch. Zazai's miserable time at the crease comes to an end.
Kesrick Williams is back on. 1-0-8-0 are his figures so far.
It's been driven superbly through the covers. One run added to the total.
Afghan lofts this one over mid on for a single.
FOUR! Short ball on middle and leg, Afghan looks to pull but gets a top edge on it. The ball goes uppishly towards fine leg for a boundary.
Short of a length on middle, Zazai pulls this one towards square leg for one.
Wide! Another one which is way outside off. Zazai looks to put bat on ball but misses.
FOUR! Shortish outside off, Zazai cuts this one past point and the ball races towards the fence.
Wide! Way wide outside off, Zazai looks to slash at it but misses.
Short ball on middle, Afghan pulls this one towards square leg for one.
Sherfane Rutherford is into the attack.
On the pads of Zazai, he defends this one out.
Full ball wide outside off, Zazai looks to put bat on ball but misses.
Almost a yorker length ball, Afghan jams this one out towards long on for a single.
Length delivery on off, Zazai slaps it to covers where Keemo Paul makes a brilliant stop. The batsmen cross ends.

Problems for Fabian Allen! While throwing the ball, he seemed to be in an uncomfortable position. He is seen clutching his right knee. The physio is out in the middle and Allen is being helped out of the ground. One bowler short are the Windies now.
Short delivery on middle, Afghan pulls it through mid-wicket for a single.
On a good length on off, Afghan defends it off the back foot.
Another shorter one, this time Zazai gets out of the way. End of the Powerplay and Afghanistan are 38/2.
Length ball outside off, played to point.
Short of a length ball, Afghan pulls this one towards square leg for a single,
Kieron Pollard is into the attack.
Wide! Whoa. That is miles down the leg side, almost 2 feet wide! Zazai does not even bother to play the shot.
Full ball on middle, Afghan looks to jam it out towards the leg side but misses. The ball goes off the inner half towards square leg.
Full ball on middle and off, Zazai pushes this one down to long off for one.

NOT OUT! Good cricket by both sides! Excellent ball by Holder to start, bowls a yorker on the leg pole. Zazai does well to jam it out towards square leg and the batters look for a couple. The fielder there rushes to the ball, throws it towards the keeper's end who takes the bails off. Zazai puts in a dive to get in. The umpire refers it upstairs for a double check. The replays show that he is well in.
Run out appeal! Looks safe.
On a good length and outside off, Afghan looks to cut but gets an outside edge. It goes on the bounce to the keeper.
Good length delivery on leg, Zazai looks to defend but gets an inside edge on this one. It goes towards fine leg. The batsmen take a run.
Full delivery on middle, Afghan flicks it towards fine leg for a single.
On a good length on middle, Zazai tucks it towards mid-wicket for a run.
On a length on middle, Afghan flicks it through square leg for a single.
FOUR! Poor delivery from Williams. Short delivery on middle, Afghan pulls it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Kesrick Williams is into the attack.
Full ball on the pads, Afghan works this one towards backward square leg for a single.
Beauty by Holder to back up the previous hit. he bowls another yorker, angling into Afghan. Afghan just about manages to dig it out.
SIX! What a way to get off the mark! Holder bowls this one on a good length on off, Afghan just stands tall and slams this one over mid-wicket for a biggie.
What a delivery on a Free Hit! Holder pulls one out of the top drawer and bowls it right in the blockhole. Zazai jams it out towards the leg side and just the single off it.
Free Hit coming up!
No ball! Overstepping by Holder! Full length ball on off, Zazai drives this one towards cover. Replays roll in and show that this overstepping call is a very close one. Doubtful!
FOUR! Good adjustment by the batsmen. This one is on the hips of Zazai, he adjusts his body and works this one towards fine leg for a boundary.
Length ball on off, pushed towards the man at mid off.
Length ball on middle and off, Afghan defends this one out.
Zazai pushes this one towards mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR LEG BYES! Down the leg side again, Zazai looks to flick but the ball kisses his pads and roll towards the fine leg fence.
Full ball on leg, Zazai looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads.
Asghar Afghan is the next batsman in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Another wicket down and double trouble for Afghanistan! Short of a length ball on the body, Zadran looks to pull this one but gets a top edge on this one. The ball flies towards mid-wicket where Fabian Allen is positioned. He settles himself under the ball and takes the catch. West Indies well and truly on top here!
On the pads of Zazai, he flicks this one towards square leg for a single.
Full ball on off, Zadran lofts this one over covers for a couple. A successful over for the Windies.
Length ball outside off, Zadran gets an educated edge on this one as he tries to guide this one down to third man.
Good length ball on off, pushed out by Zadran.
Ibrahim Zadran is the new batsman in. He is making his T20I debut tonight.

OUT! CAUGHT! A very good shot but straight to the man! Fuller ball on middle, Gurbaz looks to attack from the word go. He walks across his crease and looks to paddle-flick it but the ball goes uppishly straight to Brandon King at short fine leg. An early blow for Afghanistan as their explosive opener departs. He is known as the AB de Villiers of Afghanistan. Not quite living up to that legend's name.
Length ball on middle and off, Zazai looks to flick it towards the leg side but gets a leading edge on it. The ball lobs over the cover-point fielder and the batters take one.
Good length ball on middle, angling away. Zazai looks to have a poke at it but misses.
Jason Holder to bowl from the other end.
Another length ball on middle and off, Zazai pushes this one towards mid on and retains strike. Good start for the Windies!
Length ball on middle and off, Zazai blocks it out.
Short of a length on off, Zazai this time connects and pulls this one towards deep mid-wicket for a couple. Zazai is off the mark and so are the Afghans.
Length ball wide outside off, Zazai goes for a wild slash outside off but misses.
On the thigh pad of Zazai, he looks to flick but misses to get hit on the thigh pad.
Length ball outside off, Zazai cuts this one towards point. Hayden Walsh dives there to his right and saves at least a run. Good start!

The West Indies fielders come out of the dugout, led by skipper Kieron Pollard. The Afghanistan openers, Hazratullah Zazai and Rahmanullah Gurbaz follow them. Sheldon Cottrell to start the proceedings with the ball.
